framework.data_agent: langchain 0.2 + langchain-openai (tool-calling agent, optional NL path only)

agents.name: data_agent
agents.role: Fetches and joins rows from data/*.csv for a claimed_order_id. No LLM in this path (DataAgent.investigate).

optional_llm_path.description: DataAgent.chat() answers free-text questions via LangChain tool-calling; not used by the deterministic orchestrator run that produced output/.
optional_llm_path.note: Chosen for its OpenAI-compatible tool-calling support during development; exceeds the assignment's 10B-parameter cap and was accepted as a known deviation for this optional, unused-in-scoring path only.

agents.name: policy_agent
agents.role: Applies EC_POLICY_V2 to a data_agent bundle: primary/secondary issue, root cause, refund amount, resolution_actions. Deterministic rule engine, not an LLM call.

agents.name: execution_agent
agents.role: Simulates performing policy_agent's resolution_actions, split by domain: refund_agent (issue/reject/verify refunds), payment_agent (split-payment explanation/verification), logistics_agent (seller/carrier review, multi-seller coordination). Olist has no refund ledger to write to, so each action produces an auditable log entry rather than a real state mutation.

agents.name: orchestrator
agents.role: Routing agent: sequences data_agent -> policy_agent -> execution_agent -> verifier per case, writes output/EC_*.json, and logs every handoff to logging/trace.jsonl.

agents.name: verifier
agents.role: Pre-write gate inside orchestrator/verifier.py: checks array-length limits, evidence_id formats, confidence range, and case_status/refund consistency before a case is written to output/.
